_source: Official Allen-Bradley Publication A117-CA001A-EN-P, p. 12-8. The target 1492-J3 is the first of three explicit variant columns; its Maximum Current row begins 25 A / 20 A / 24 A / 21 A, while 35 A begins the neighbouring 1492-J4 column.

_notes.scope: J4 and J6 product/ordering-code columns are sibling variants and must not be emitted for the target J3. An unscoped row that contains both target and sibling catalogues is suppressed rather than shown as a J3 attribute.
_notes.color: The source's J3 ordering row says Grey, but the positioned reader does not yet reconstruct this row-oriented ordering block. `normalized:color` is an explicit known gap; outputting sibling J4/J6 codes is not acceptable.
_notes.voltage: The J3 column publishes 600V AC/DC (plus certification-specific 800V and 550V values); this fixture only asserts the target's published 600V value.
